ToneOptions.Label: Innovative & Strategic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Emphasize future-state innovation and strategic advantage through advanced cloud operations.

ToneOptions.Label: Precise & Technical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a highly precise, technical, and objective tone, focusing on architectural specifics.

ToneOptions.Label: Performance-Oriented
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Focus on system performance, scalability, and efficiency for real-time incident intelligence.

ToneOptions.Label: Developer-Centric
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a clear, instructional tone, guiding junior developers through implementation details.

GoalOptions.Label: Architectural Alignment
GoalOptions.Text: Ensure all microservices adhere to the prescribed event-driven architecture, promoting loose coupling and high cohesion. This document aims to be the definitive blueprint for system design and integration, preventing architectural drift.

GoalOptions.Label: Operational Efficiency
GoalOptions.Text: For the DevOps team, the goal is to provide clear deployment, monitoring, and operational guidelines. This ensures the AIOps platform achieves its target MTTR reduction and on-call incident volume decrease through robust automation and observability.

GoalOptions.Label: ML Model Integration
GoalOptions.Text: For the ML Engineering team, the goal is to detail the integration points and data contracts for ML model deployment and lifecycle management. This ensures seamless ingestion of model outputs for anomaly detection and root-cause analysis, maintaining high accuracy.

GoalOptions.Label: Feature Implementation
GoalOptions.Text: For junior developers, the goal is to provide sufficient detail to implement specific features and components of the AIOps platform. This includes clear API specifications, data flow diagrams, and component responsibilities to accelerate development cycles.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Architectural
Criteria: All event streams are defined with clear schemas and idempotency guarantees.
Microservice boundaries are well-defined, adhering to domain-driven design principles.
Data ingestion pipelines support at least 100,000 events/second with <500ms latency.
ML model inference latency for incident detection is consistently below 200ms.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Performance
Criteria: Platform achieves 99.99% availability for continuous monitoring capabilities.
Automated remediation playbooks execute within 5 seconds of incident detection.
System scales horizontally to accommodate 5x peak observability data volume.
Mean Time To Recover (MTTR) for critical incidents is reduced by 60% post-deployment.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Development & Maintainability
Criteria: All new code adheres to established coding standards and passes static analysis checks.
Each microservice has comprehensive unit and integration test coverage (>80%).
Documentation for each component is up-to-date and reflects current implementation.
Onboarding time for a new developer to contribute to a core service is less than 2 weeks.
